name: Documentation
description: Documentation App — clone, browse and edit a docs git repository added to a space.

apps.title: Documentation
apps.description: Browse and edit a documentation repository.

parameters.label: Access token
parameters.description: Secrets Store key holding the git token, as <storeId>/<key>

actions.description: Find the pages that answer a question. Pass `query`: the words you expect on the page, in any order, case-insensitive ("worktree node_modules install"); a word also finds its plural and -ing/-ed forms, and "quoted text" must appear as written. Pages holding every word come first, ranked so that rare words and words in the title, a heading or the path count most; when no page holds them all, the closest pages are returned, each with the words it lacks. Use 2-4 distinctive words (names, commands, identifiers) rather than a sentence. Pass `pattern` instead for a regular expression (JavaScript syntax with the `u` flag, case-insensitive), e.g. `^## ` to list sections; escape only characters that need it (`\#` is refused), and a pattern that runs for over a second is stopped. Searches this app by default; `apps: "*"` searches every documentation app in one ranked list. Only the published version is searched; drafts never match. The answer is text: each page with its path, title and best matching lines (`L<line>`), then how to `read` from a line.

query.description: Words to find, in any order; "quoted text" as written.

pattern.description: A regular expression instead of query (JavaScript syntax, case-insensitive).

apps.description: Where to search: "*" for every documentation app, or a list of app addresses (<space>.<app-slug>). Default: this app.

limit.description: Pages to return, best first (default 6, at most 100).

actions.description: Read a doc by its relative path (must end with .md). Default reads the PUBLISHED version, the one readers see (the branch as pushed to its remote); a page never published has none and the read fails. Pass version "draft" for saved-but-unpublished working-tree edits. Optional offset/limit slice by 1-indexed line.

version.description: Which content to read: "published" (default) or "draft" (the unpublished draft, including what people are typing into it right now).

limit.description: Number of lines to return. Default: read to end.

actions.description: Replace an exact string in a doc. Fails if oldString is not unique unless replaceAll is true. Mirrors the behavior of the regular Edit tool.
Create or overwrite a doc. Creates parent directories as needed. Path must end with .md.

Commit and push a page's draft. Other pages' drafts are not pulled into the commit. The page must start with its title, a level-1 heading (`# Title`), and is saved in the file named after that title (`index.md` and `README.md` keep their names): when the title changed, the file is moved in the same commit and every relative link to it is rewritten. Refused when the title is missing or empty, or another page or folder beside it has that name. The answer's `path` is where the page is now (`previousPath` when it moved); `unrewrittenLinks` lists what was left as written: links that could not be rewritten, and mentions of the old path in text, code or full addresses.

path.description: Relative path of the page to publish.

actions.description: Move a page or a folder into another folder, or to another place in its own folder, committed and pushed at once. Its drafts move along and stay drafts; every relative link to and from what moves is rewritten, in published pages and drafts. The folders' meta files (`_meta.json`) keep the new order. Refused when the target folder already has a page or folder of that name, or a folder would go into itself. The answer's `path` is where it is now; `unrewrittenLinks` lists what was left as written: links that could not be rewritten, and mentions of the old path in text, code or full addresses.

path.description: Relative path of the page (`guides/intro.md`) or folder (`guides`) to move.

toFolder.description: The folder to move it into; "" (default) is the top level.

position.description: Its place among the entries already in that folder, 0 first. Default: last.

actions.description: Give a folder a title, kept in its meta file (`_meta.json`), and name the folder after it: the folder is renamed to the title's slug, committed and pushed at once, with every relative link into it rewritten. Refused when the title is empty, has no letters or digits, or another page or folder beside it has that name.

Delete a page, or a folder with everything in it, committed and pushed at once. Drafts of the deleted pages are dropped, for everyone editing one, and so are pages that were never published. Its name is taken out of its folder's meta file (`_meta.json`). Links to it are not changed: `unrewrittenLinks` lists every page that still links to it or mentions its path, with the line, to fix by hand. The answer's `sha` is the commit, null when only never-published pages went. Refused for the top level, or a path that names no page or folder.

path.description: Relative path of the page (`guides/intro.md`) or folder (`guides`) to delete.

actions.description: Pull the latest changes from the remote (rebase).
